lines.text: Jesus withdrew by boat to a solitary place, and when He stepped ashore He healed the sick.
In the evening the disciples asked Jesus to send the crowds to the villages to buy food.
Jesus told the disciples to feed the crowd, but they had only seven loaves and two fish.
Jesus had the crowds sit, looked up to Zion, broke the loaves, and gave them to the disciples.
They all ate and were satisfied, the disciples gathered twelve basketfuls, and about five thousand men were fed.
